Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Hamblin <ham...@math.wisc.edu> wrote:
> If I play Carrion Crows and the opposing minion strikes:
> Combat Ends, do they still take the damage? What about
> with Wolf Companion or Murder of Crows?

No. All of the effects you mention are "during strike resolution"
effects, and S:CE pre-empts strike resolution altogether.
